name: Question 19
worked_solution:
Taking the natural logarithm of both sides and applying the laws of logarithms, we get the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{4}^{1-2x} & \le 3\cdot {5}^{2-3x} \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡({4}^{1-2x}) & \le \operatorname{ln}⁡(3\cdot {5}^{2-3x}) \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡({4}^{1-2x}) & \le \operatorname{ln}⁡(3)+\operatorname{ln}⁡({5}^{2-3x}) \\ (1-2x)\operatorname{ln}⁡4 & \le \operatorname{ln}⁡3+(2-3x)\operatorname{ln}⁡5 \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡4-2x\operatorname{ln}⁡4 & \le \operatorname{ln}⁡3+2\operatorname{ln}⁡5-3x\operatorname{ln}⁡5 \\ 3x\operatorname{ln}⁡5-2x\operatorname{ln}⁡4 & \le \operatorname{ln}⁡3+2\operatorname{ln}⁡5-\operatorname{ln}⁡4 \\ x(3\operatorname{ln}⁡5-2\operatorname{ln}⁡4) & \le \operatorname{ln}⁡3+2\operatorname{ln}⁡5-\operatorname{ln}⁡4 \\ x & \le \frac{\operatorname{ln}⁡3+2\operatorname{ln}⁡5-\operatorname{ln}⁡4}{3\operatorname{ln}⁡5-2\operatorname{ln}⁡4}\end{aligned}
$$

Solve the inequality 41−2x≤3⋅52−3x.

a
x≥2ln⁡5−ln⁡43ln⁡5+2ln⁡4
b
x≥ln⁡3−ln⁡43ln⁡5−2ln⁡4
c
x≤ln⁡3+ln⁡5−ln⁡4ln⁡5+2ln⁡4

x≤ln⁡3+2ln⁡5−ln⁡43ln⁡5−2ln⁡4
e
x≤2ln⁡5+ln⁡43ln⁡5−2ln⁡4

EXPLANATION
